description: PNG of a screen, one mockup variant (mockup + variant) or, on its own, a definition node ref — exactly one target. node clips a screen to one element (+8px): far fewer vision tokens. For a mockup, width sets the viewport (default 390) and the capture is full-page; a screen renders at its root's declared size. scale 1-3 (default 1) multiplies vision cost. browser re-renders in another installed engine; the result names the one used.
name: get_screenshot
